valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 diluted EPS per ADS viewed at the 12-month target date; 1 ADS = 2 ordinary shares; USD/TWD 32.838 on 2026-11-13)

bear.driver: AI/LEAP advanced packaging ramp slows or elevated CapEx ($11.5B in FY26) weighs on depreciation and ATM gross margin slips below 28%

base.driver: LEAP revenue roughly doubles in FY27 from >$4B in FY26, supporting consolidated gross margin near 23%-24% and operating margin ~15%

bull.driver: Tight advanced-packaging capacity drives stronger pricing power, ATM gross margin sustains >30%, and LEAP exceeds expectations

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $2.22, the $35.55 close implies 16.0x P/E; the published consensus target of ~$55.00 implies 24.8x P/E (or $2.75 EPS at 20.0x).
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $2.22 (+6.2 percentage points of price return).
valuation.watch_metric: ATM segment gross margin (30.6% in Q3 2026) and full-year LEAP advanced packaging revenue trajectory

analyst_notes: Individual named analyst calls with exact issue dates could not be verified, so named-analyst coverage is marked unavailable. Published Street consensus rates ASX a Strong Buy with an average target around $54.94-$55.00 (range $51.88-$58.00, including Bank of America Securities raising its target to $58.00 from $51.00 in October 2026), which sits ~24 percentage points above our $44.40 base case and implies ~24.8x base FY2027 EPS.
